shellCommands.command: git ls-files | head -50 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && ls
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules | head -50; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

ls node_modules | grep -iE "mark|remark|unified|mdast|micromark|react-markdown|marked|yfm|diplodoc|codemirror|uiw"; ls node_modules/@uiw node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null | head
timeout 60 npm view react-markdown version 2>&1 | tail -3
npm install react-markdown remark-gfm 2>&1 | tail -5 && git diff package.json
